# Atayana Indicator Service
The Atayana Indicator service is the core implementation of the Atayana Indicators library spec. It hosts all the necessary conveinence functions and symbols for indictators.

## Features
 - Core to the Atayana Indicators spec
 - Provides conveinences functions for indicators
 - Provides symbols for indicators.
